# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(xgboost)
  library(PRROC)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)

OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")
MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions")

run_name <- "xgBoost_aggregated_featureAblation"

data_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data_aggregated.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files",
                            "training_data_snppg_aggregated.tsv.gz")

model_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, run_name)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Load Data
```{r}
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data  <- fread(training_file)
```

# 3. Select Groups
```{r}
groups <- list(
  distance      = c("peak_gene_distance","closest_tss","distNearest_peakCentric"),
  acc_mean      = c("ATACmean","peak_logCPM"),
  acc_var       = c("ATACvariance"),
  coaccess      = c("cicero","scent","signac"),
  motif_arch    = c("rex"),
  predEnhancer  = c("predEnhancer_g_exp_beta","predEnhancer_g_exp_score",
                    "predEnhancer_g_lin_beta","predEnhancer_g_lin_score",
                    "predEnhancer_p_exp_beta","predEnhancer_p_exp_score",
                    "predEnhancer_p_lin_beta","predEnhancer_p_lin_score"),
  topology_3d   = c("tad_n_boundaries","tad_pyt_score","tad_sum_score"),
  conservation  = c("conservation"),
  gene_expr     = c("gene_logCPM")
)

groups <- lapply(groups, function(v) intersect(v, names(full_data)))
groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
baseline_feats <- sort(unique(unlist(groups)))
stopifnot(length(baseline_feats) > 0)

cat("Baseline feature count:", length(baseline_feats), "\n")
```

# 4. Merge
```{r}
index_cols <- c("peak","gene","celltype")

ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",      # fuse IN → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",      # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

training_data[, celltype := ifelse(celltype %in% names(ct_map),
                                   ct_map[celltype], celltype)]
stopifnot(all(index_cols %in% names(full_data)), all(index_cols %in% names(training_data)))
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

restrict_peaks <- unique(training_data$peak)

# Labels 1=pos, 2=strong neg → 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L,1L)]
```

# 5.  Held-out cell types
```{r}
# Recompute held-outs AFTER mapping/join, so LOCTO sees the exact same CT names as baseline
LOO_colname <- "celltype"
heldouts <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[LOO_colname]])))
cat("Held-out cell types:", paste(heldouts, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Make sure the features actually exist post-merge
groups <- lapply(groups, function(v) intersect(v, names(data)))
groups <- groups[lengths(groups) > 0]
baseline_feats <- sort(unique(unlist(groups)))
stopifnot(length(baseline_feats) > 0)
```

# 6. Metric Helpers
```{r}
logloss <- function(y, p, eps = 1e-15) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps)
  -mean(y*log(p) + (1 - y)*log(1 - p))
}

score_fold <- function(y_true, p_hat, peaks, restrict_peaks) {
  stopifnot(all(y_true %in% c(0,1)))
  both_classes <- any(y_true==1) && any(y_true==0)
  if (both_classes) {
    pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_true==1],
                          scores.class1 = p_hat[y_true==0], curve = FALSE)
    ro <- PRROC::roc.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_true==1],
                           scores.class1 = p_hat[y_true==0], curve = FALSE)
    auprc <- pr$auc.integral; auc <- ro$auc
  } else {
    auprc <- NA_real_; auc <- NA_real_
  }

  # Global average enrichment
  avg_enrich_global <- calc_avg_enrichment(y_true, p_hat)

  # Restricted-to-training-peaks average enrichment
  keep <- peaks %in% restrict_peaks
  if (any(keep) && any(y_true[keep] == 1)) {
    avg_enrich_restrict <- calc_avg_enrichment(y_true[keep], p_hat[keep])
  } else {
    avg_enrich_restrict <- NA_real_
  }

  data.table(
    auprc = auprc,
    auc   = auc,
    logloss = logloss(y_true, p_hat),
    avg_enrichment_global   = avg_enrich_global,
    avg_enrichment_restrict = avg_enrich_restrict
  )
}

calc_avg_enrichment <- function(y_true, scores) {
  stopifnot(length(y_true) == length(scores))
  ord <- order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)
  y_true <- y_true[ord]

  n_true <- sum(y_true == 1)
  if (n_true == 0) return(NA_real_)

  # cumulative TP count
  tp <- cumsum(y_true == 1)
  pred <- seq_along(y_true)

  # recall and enrichment at each prediction
  recall <- tp / n_true
  frac_pred <- pred / length(y_true)
  enrichment <- (tp / n_true) / frac_pred

  # average enrichment: mean of enrichment values at true positive steps
  avg_enrichment <- mean(enrichment[y_true == 1])

  return(avg_enrichment)
}

```

# 7. Run loCTo Function
```{r}
run_locto <- function(feat_set, tag = "baseline", save_models = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(length(feat_set) > 0)

  all_preds <- list()
  per_fold  <- list()
  cv_curves <- list()
  best_rounds <- list()

  for (ct in heldouts) {
    cat(sprintf("\nHeld-out cell type: %s\n", ct))

    test_idx  <- data[[LOO_colname]] == ct
    train_idx <- !test_idx

    X_train <- as.matrix(data[train_idx, ..feat_set])
    y_train <- data$label[train_idx]
    X_test  <- as.matrix(data[test_idx, ..feat_set])
    y_test  <- data$label[test_idx]

    # chromosome folds
    chrs_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
    folds <- split(seq_along(chrs_train), chrs_train)

    dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)

    # --- CV for best nrounds ---
    cv <- xgb.cv(
      data = dtrain,
      folds = folds,
      max_depth        = 6,
      eta              = 0.05,
      gamma            = 10,
      min_child_weight = 6,
      subsample        = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 1.0,
      nrounds          = 500,
      nthread          = 8,
      objective        = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric      = "aucpr",
      early_stopping_rounds = 5,
      verbose = 0
    )

    best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
    best_rounds[[ct]] <- best_nrounds
    cat(sprintf("Best nrounds: %d\n", best_nrounds))

    # --- Train final model ---
    bst <- xgboost(
      data             = dtrain,
      max_depth        = 6,
      eta              = 0.05,
      gamma            = 10,
      min_child_weight = 6,
      subsample        = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 1.0,
      nrounds          = best_nrounds,
      nthread          = 8,
      objective        = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric      = "aucpr",
      verbose          = 0
    )

    if (save_models) {
      safe_ct <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ct)
      model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("xgb_locto_%s_%s.model", tag, safe_ct))
      xgb.save(bst, model_path)
    }

    # --- Predict on held-out CT ---
    p_hat <- predict(bst, X_test)
    all_preds[[ct]] <- data.table(
      heldout = ct,
      data[test_idx, ..index_cols],
      xgBoost_probability = p_hat,
      label = y_test
    )

    # --- Metrics ---
    mets <- score_fold(
      y_true = y_test,
      p_hat  = p_hat,
      peaks  = data$peak[test_idx],
      restrict_peaks = restrict_peaks
    )

    per_fold[[ct]] <- cbind(
      data.table(heldout = ct, n_val = length(y_test), run_tag = tag),
      mets
    )

    # --- Store CV curves ---
    e <- cv$evaluation_log
    e$celltype <- ct
    cv_curves[[ct]] <- e
  }

  per_fold <- rbindlist(per_fold)
  preds    <- rbindlist(all_preds)
  eval_log <- rbindlist(cv_curves)

  summary <- per_fold[, .(
    auprc   = mean(auprc,   na.rm = TRUE),
    auc     = mean(auc,     na.rm = TRUE),
    logloss = mean(logloss, na.rm = TRUE)
  )]

  list(
    per_fold  = per_fold,
    summary   = summary,
    preds     = preds,
    cv_curves = eval_log,
    best_rounds = best_rounds
  )
}

```

# 8. Run Baseline
```{r}
cat("Training baseline with", length(baseline_feats), "features …\n")
base_run <- run_locto(baseline_feats, tag = "base", save_models = TRUE)
print(base_run$summary)
fwrite(base_run$per_fold, file.path(model_dir, "baseline_per_fold.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(base_run$preds,    file.path(model_dir, "baseline_predictions.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(base_run$cv_curves,file.path(model_dir, "baseline_cv.tsv"), sep = "\t")

```

# 9. Run Ablations
```{r}
ablation_rows <- lapply(names(groups), function(g) {
  drop <- groups[[g]]
  keep <- setdiff(baseline_feats, drop)

  runG <- run_locto(keep, tag = paste0("drop_", g), save_models = TRUE)

  # --- Save detailed outputs ---
  fwrite(runG$per_fold,  file.path(model_dir, sprintf("per_fold_%s.tsv", g)), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(runG$preds,     file.path(model_dir, sprintf("predictions_%s.tsv", g)), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(runG$cv_curves, file.path(model_dir, sprintf("cv_curves_%s.tsv", g)), sep = "\t")

  # --- Paired deltas with baseline ---
  d_per_fold <- merge(
    runG$per_fold[, .(heldout,
                      auprc_ab = auprc, auc_ab = auc, logloss_ab = logloss,
                      enrich_glob_ab = avg_enrichment_global,
                      enrich_restr_ab = avg_enrichment_restrict)],
    base_run$per_fold[, .(heldout,
                          auprc_base = auprc, auc_base = auc, logloss_base = logloss,
                          enrich_glob_base = avg_enrichment_global,
                          enrich_restr_base = avg_enrichment_restrict)],
    by = "heldout"
  )[, .(
    d_auprc            = auprc_ab   - auprc_base,
    d_auc              = auc_ab     - auc_base,
    d_logloss          = logloss_ab - logloss_base,
    d_enrich_global    = enrich_glob_ab  - enrich_glob_base,
    d_enrich_restrict  = enrich_restr_ab - enrich_restr_base
  )]

  data.table(
    group                = g,
    n_drop               = length(drop),
    n_keep               = length(keep),
    auprc                = runG$summary$auprc,
    auc                  = runG$summary$auc,
    logloss              = runG$summary$logloss,
    avg_enrich_global    = mean(runG$per_fold$avg_enrichment_global,   na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_enrich_restrict  = mean(runG$per_fold$avg_enrichment_restrict, na.rm = TRUE),
    d_auprc              = mean(d_per_fold$d_auprc,           na.rm = TRUE),
    d_auc                = mean(d_per_fold$d_auc,             na.rm = TRUE),
    d_logloss            = mean(d_per_fold$d_logloss,         na.rm = TRUE),
    d_enrich_global      = mean(d_per_fold$d_enrich_global,   na.rm = TRUE),
    d_enrich_restrict    = mean(d_per_fold$d_enrich_restrict, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
})

ablation_tbl <- rbindlist(ablation_rows)[order(d_auprc)]
print(ablation_tbl)

fwrite(ablation_tbl, file.path(model_dir, "ablation_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")


```

# 10. Plot
```{r fig.width= 10, fig.height=5}
ablation_tbl <- fread(file.path(model_dir, "ablation_summary.tsv"))

# Human-readable group names
group_labels <- c(
  distance      = "Distance features",
  acc_mean      = "Chromatin accessibility (mean)",
  acc_var       = "Chromatin accessibility (variance)",
  coaccess      = "Regulatory linkage features\n(SCENT, Cicero, Signac)",
  motif_arch    = "Motif architecture",
  predEnhancer  = "Predicted enhancer activity",
  topology_3d   = "3D genome topology",
  conservation  = "Sequence conservation",
  gene_expr     = "Gene expression"
)

# Apply labels
ablation_tbl[, group := group_labels[group]]

# Explicitly order by d_auprc (lowest first)
ablation_tbl[, group := factor(group, levels = group[order(d_auprc)])]

# Plot
ggplot(ablation_tbl,
       aes(x = group, y = d_auprc)) +  # no reorder() here
  geom_col(fill = "#1b9e77", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Feature group removed",
    y = expression(Delta~"AUPRC"),
    title = "Feature Ablation: Change in AUPRC",
    subtitle = "Performance drop relative to baseline model"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15, base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", family = "montserrat_family"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = "montserrat_family"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = "montserrat_family")
  )

```

# Plots for thesis
```{r fig.height = 10, fig.width= 10}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)  # for ggcorr / ggpairs
library(corrplot)  # for correlation heatmaps

# Select features only
feature_cols <- baseline_feats  # the same features used for training
feature_data <- data[, ..feature_cols]

# Remove any non-numeric columns
feature_data <- feature_data[, which(sapply(feature_data, is.numeric)), with = FALSE]

cor_mat <- cor(feature_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

# Define a mapping
feature_labels <- c(
  peak_gene_distance = "Distance from peak to gene",
  closest_tss        = "Binary value for closest connection",
  distNearest_peakCentric = "Candidate-centric distance",
  ATACmean           = "ATAC mean signal",
  ATACvariance       = "ATAC variance",
  cicero             = "Cicero",
  scent              = "SCENT",
  signac             = "Signac",
  rex                = "Range extender motifs",
  predEnhancer_g_exp_beta  = "PredEnhancer β (gene exp)",
  predEnhancer_g_lin_beta  = "PredEnhancer β (linear)",
  predEnhancer_p_exp_beta  = "PredEnhancer β (peak exp)",
  predEnhancer_p_lin_beta  = "PredEnhancer β (peak linear)",
  predEnhancer_g_exp_score  = "PredEnhancer score (gene exp)",
  predEnhancer_g_lin_score  = "PredEnhancer score (linear)",
  predEnhancer_p_exp_score = "PredEnhancer score (peak exp)",
  predEnhancer_p_lin_score  = "PredEnhancer score (peak linear)",
  tad_sum_score      = "TAD sum score",
  tad_n_boundaries = "TAD boundaries crossed",
  tad_pyt_score = "TAD pythagorean score",
  conservation        = "Sequence conservation",
  gene_logCPM         = "Gene expression logCPM",
  peak_logCPM = "Peak logCPM"
)

# Apply renaming
new_names <- ifelse(names(feature_labels) %in% colnames(cor_mat),
                    feature_labels[colnames(cor_mat)],
                    colnames(cor_mat))
rownames(cor_mat) <- new_names
colnames(cor_mat) <- new_names

corrplot(
  cor_mat,
  method = "color",
  type = "lower",                # show only lower triangle
  order = "hclust",              # cluster features
  col = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue3", "white", "firebrick3"))(200),
  tl.col = "black",              # text color
  tl.srt = 0,                    # keep feature names horizontal
  tl.pos = "l",                  # label only on the left
  cl.pos = "n",                  # remove color scale legend
  mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0),
  title = "Feature correlation matrix (Spearman)"
)
```
